cases.description: A warm jacket for a cold trek, with a budget written as "8k" and a size.

turns.user: I'm going trekking in Ladakh in December, need a jacket under 8k, size L.
turns.reply:
Ladakh in December is extremely cold, so warmth is inferred (high/extreme).
Ladakh in December needs serious insulation, so the extreme-warmth down jackets come first, and the TrekNorth Summit and Monsoonwear Ridge are also waterproof. The fleece jackets work better as a mid-layer under one of these. Note that the AltiGear Basecamp is cut for women.

cases.description: Shoe type, a waterproof attribute and a UK size.

turns.reply: UrbanStep Glide and TrailKing Terra are well rated and cost less, and TrailKing Terra is unisex. The highest-rated pair is the PaceOne Breeze, but it's a women's shoe, so check the gender on each card.

cases.description: A boolean attribute with a "15k" budget.

turns.user: A 5G phone under 15k with a good battery
turns.reply: The Pixelon Nova is the best all-rounder here, with a big battery and the highest rating. The Aurora Zen and Novaphone Nova have even bigger batteries but lower ratings, and the Kirin Neo is the cheapest well-rated pick.

cases.description: A boolean attribute with a numeric minimum.

turns.user: A waterproof trekking backpack, at least 40 litres
turns.reply: The Commuto Ascent 54 L and TrailCarry Explorer 42 L are the top-rated picks here, and they cost less than most of the others. If you need more room for long treks, look at the 65–70 L UrbanSling Explorer bags.

cases.description: Three attributes, one of which (gender) also accepts unisex.

turns.user: An analog watch with a leather strap for men
turns.reply: The Kaal Luxe is a good middle pick for quality and price, and the Kaal Pulse is the premium choice with the most reviews. The Horizon Active costs the least, but its rating is lower.

cases.description: An appliance type with a budget.

turns.reply: The Annapurna Eco has the best rating and a 3-year warranty. The Swaad Turbo is the one to pick for a bigger family, since it has the largest basket and a 5-year warranty.

cases.description: Adding an attribute keeps the earlier budget and size.

turns.user: I'm going trekking in Ladakh in December, need a jacket under 8k, size L.
turns.reply:
Ladakh in December gets extremely cold, so I'm treating high warmth as a requirement I worked out myself, not one you gave.
The down jackets with extreme warmth suit Ladakh in December best, and the UrbanLayer Pamir is very light and waterproof. The fleece is better used as a mid-layer, and check the gender on each card, since the AltiGear Basecamp is a women's fit.
The top four have extreme warmth and are the safest picks for December, and the UrbanLayer Pamir is the lightest. The Himfrost Summit is the only unisex one here, and the rest are men's fits.

cases.description: Narrowing to one brand keeps the type and budget.

turns.reply: The PaceOne Terra and TrailKing Apex are the best-rated picks, but neither is waterproof. If you'll trek in the rain, the UrbanStep Glide (men) or TrailKing Metro (women) are waterproof options.

The Apex (SHO-00021) is the best value but isn't waterproof. For wet trails, the unisex Metro (SHO-00221) is the top-rated waterproof pick, and the Terra (SHO-00279) is a waterproof option that costs less.

cases.description: "The second one" resolves against the shown list. The second-cheapest backpack is an UrbanSling.

turns.reply: The UrbanSling Ridge is the only one of these with waterproofing and a laptop compartment. The Commuto Ridge has the best rating and the most space.

turns.user: Tell me more about the second one
turns.reply: The UrbanSling Ridge 34 L Travel Backpack costs ₹439 (MRP ₹505) and comes in maroon or black, with a 3.8 rating from 1,719 reviews. It's a waterproof travel bag with a laptop compartment, several pockets for small items and padded shoulder straps, and it's in stock.

cases.description: Comparing the first two shown. The two cheapest phones are a Zentrix and an Aurora.

turns.reply: The Aurora Neo costs a little more than the Zentrix, but it has twice the storage, a bigger battery and the highest rating of the three. None of these phones has 5G.

The Aurora Neo at ₹7,229 is better in every way that differs: 128 GB storage instead of 64 GB, a 5237 mAh battery instead of 4223 mAh, a 64 MP camera instead of 12 MP, a 6.3" screen and a 4.6 rating. The Zentrix Neo only wins on price at ₹7,099, and both have 4 GB RAM and no 5G.

cases.description: No category or use case can be inferred.

turns.user: I need a gift for my sister.
turns.reply: Happy to help! What kind of gift do you have in mind for her, for example a watch, kurta, jacket, shoes or bag?

cases.description: A category the store doesn't carry.

turns.reply: Sorry, we don't sell televisions. Our store carries jackets, shoes, phones, laptops, backpacks, watches, kurtas and kitchen appliances, and I'd be glad to help you find something in any of those.

cases.description: No gaming laptop is under ₹55,000; raising the budget by 15% (to ₹63,250) finds some.

turns.reply: No gaming laptops under ₹55,000, so I raised the budget to ₹63,250 and found these. The Lumen Swift is cheapest and the Quanta Pro has a high-tier CPU but the lowest rating.

cases.description: An inferred extreme-warmth filter finds nothing under ₹2,000; dropping it (the user never said it) does.

turns.reply: Nothing under ₹2,000 has extreme warmth, so I dropped that filter. None of these is made for -20°C: the fleece and denim jackets give moderate warmth and will only work as layers, so for real -20°C cold you'd need a bigger budget.

cases.description: "Shaadi" maps to the wedding occasion and "5k tak" to a budget.

turns.user: Shaadi ke liye silk kurta chahiye, 5k tak
turns.reply: Men aur women dono ke options hain. Kalakriti Noor sabse highly rated hai, aur men's mein DesiLoom Saanjh ya Rangsutra Royal achhe hain. Aapko kiske liye chahiye aur size kya hai?

cases.description: "Teen hazaar tak" is a budget of ₹3,000, written in Hindi number words.

turns.user: Teen hazaar tak ki watch dikhao
turns.reply: Analog style ke liye Chronex Active top-rated hai, digital mein Tempo Active sabse achhi rating wali hai. Men, women ya unisex chahiye, ya smartwatch, bataiye toh aur filter kar doon.

cases.description: "Aur sasta dikhao" is "cheaper", with the reply in Hinglish.

turns.reply: Swimming ke liye Chronex Orbit ya Meridian Pulse lo, dono 100m water resistant hain. Kam budget mein Kaal Classic ki rating sabse achhi hai.

Vela Orbit aur Horizon Active ki rating sabse high hai, aur sabse kam budget ho to Meridian Classic dekho. Tempo Heritage (grey/yellow) silicone strap ke saath aati hai, workout ke liye comfortable rahegi.

cases.description: "Dusra wala" is the second one shown. The second-cheapest kurta is a Rangsutra.

turns.reply: Pehle do women ke liye hain aur teesra men ka khadi kurta hai. Utsav wale ki rating sabse achhi hai.

Rangsutra Heritage Rayon Kurta for Women ₹409 ka hai, rayon fabric aur short sleeves ke saath daily wear ke liye bana hai, aur M, L, XL sizes mein olive ya navy mein milta hai. Iski rating 3.2 hai (999 reviews), isliye ₹399 wala Utsav cotton kurta (rating 5.0) shayad behtar rahega.

cases.description: A vague Hinglish request gets one clarifying question in Hinglish.

turns.reply: Aap kya dhoondh rahe hain, jaise jacket, joote, phone, laptop, backpack, watch, kurta ya kitchen appliance?

cases.description: An out-of-scope Hinglish request is declined in Hinglish.

turns.user: Aaj Delhi ka mausam kaisa hai?
turns.reply: Sorry, main mausam ki jaankari nahi de sakta, main sirf is store ki shopping mein help karta hoon. Agar thand ya baarish ke liye jacket ya waterproof joote chahiye, toh bataiye, main dhoondh deta hoon!
